audits.dominantPattern: Pattern 5 preamble / self-correction pivot ('No.' + correction, expected reaction then real one)
clusterWarnings: Self-correction 'No.' opener repeats three times (L25 'No. Slower.', L99 'No, unfair.', L213 'No. He'd been sure'). Two weakest killed; L213 kept as the single survivor because it answers the explicit question 'Was that fair?'.

Expectation-then-actual shape repeats in the Strahnbrad scene (L155 'He didn't take the sheet. He put...', L173 'Jaina thought he'd laugh... He only studied her'). Both killed; L233 'Sylvanas didn't ask.' kept (60 lines away, no positive action to substitute).
L117 camp-noise paragraph stacks three trailing negative tags ('nobody answered him', 'neither one listening', 'would not stop'). Weakest killed.

findings.text: No. Slower. One man couldn't drive every load in Corley's book
findings.deletionTest: One man couldn't drive every load in Corley's book... -- survives; the em-dash break at the end of L23 already shows her cutting herself off.
findings.reason: Pattern 2 two-beat refusal before the real argument; part of a three-instance 'No.' self-correction cluster (L25, L99, L213), so the repetition itself is the tic.
findings.suggestedFix: One man couldn't drive every load in Corley's book

findings.text: In the loft she had never asked what kind of keeping survives a mill, an oven and a gut.
findings.deletionTest: The content is the question; the 'had never asked' frame only primes it by naming what she failed to do.
findings.reason: Pattern 5: the sentence reaches the question by first stating she never asked it; state the question directly (also fixes the tense slip 'survives').
findings.suggestedFix: What kind of keeping could survive a mill, an oven and a gut?

findings.text: No, unfair. They were facing the smoke,
findings.deletionTest: They were facing the smoke, and the smoke was real... -- survives; the concession is carried by the content that follows.
findings.reason: Pattern 2 refusal-then-correction; second of three 'No.' self-corrections and the same scene as L213, so cluster rule applies.
findings.suggestedFix: But they were facing the smoke,

findings.pattern: NEG-P4 minimizer tag / trailing negative gloss
findings.text: Two officers on either side of a banner pole shouted at each other about a ford, neither one listening.
findings.deletionTest: Two officers on either side of a banner pole shouted at each other about a ford. -- survives; 'shouted at each other' already carries the talking-past.
findings.reason: Trailing negative tag restates the clause before it; third negative tail in a four-sentence paragraph ('nobody answered him', 'would not stop').
findings.suggestedFix: Two officers on either side of a banner pole shouted at each other about a ford.

findings.text: He didn't take the sheet. He put one gloved finger on the knife slit.
findings.deletionTest: He put one gloved finger on the knife slit. -- survives, but the not-taking is the plant for L199 'He had never taken the paper.' and L335, so the fix states it positively.
findings.reason: Pattern 5 exactly ('She did not laugh. She smiled.'): negative action then the real one. The plant survives as a positive physical fact.
findings.suggestedFix: He left the sheet in her hand and put one gloved finger on the knife slit.

findings.text: He only studied her, long and steady,
findings.deletionTest: He studied her, long and steady, as he might have a boy across the practice yard who had read his feint. -- survives and lands harder.
findings.reason: Pattern 5 camouflaged with 'only': the bigger expected reaction (laugh, snap) is named so the real one arrives diminished. Jaina's expectation sentence stays; only the minimizer goes.
findings.suggestedFix: He studied her, long and steady,
